2115752635412193405.en_summary: U.S. stocks fell (SPX -0.3%, NDX -1.0%) after weak results from $GOOG (-10%, AI search eroding adv revs) and Samsung (-4%, chip miss and high capex) revived doubts about AI returns. Fed held rates steady but Chair Warsh flagged further hikes on strong economy and sticky inflation. 10-year yield fell 2.9 bp to 4.99%. Brent crude dropped 1.6% to $113; MSFT rose 4% pre-market on Q3 beat. Other tech lagged (NVDA -0.6%, MRVL -9.8% on Lumentum talks). #BTC slid 1.4% to $80.1K. S&P 2026 EPS estimates remain +33% YoY on AI spend, but valuations stretched vs treasury yields.
2115752635412193405.zh_summary: 美股下跌（標普500指數-0.3%，納斯達克100指數-1.0%），因$GOOG業績疲弱（-10%，AI搜尋侵蝕廣告收入）及三星（-4%，晶片未達預期及高資本支出）重新引發對AI回報的疑慮。聯準會維持利率不變，但主席Warsh因經濟強勁及通膨黏性暗示可能進一步升息。10年期公債收益率下跌2.9個基點至4.99%。布蘭特原油下跌1.6%至113美元；MSFT因第三季超預期盤前上漲4%。其他科技股落後（NVDA -0.6%，MRVL因Lumentum談判-9.8%）。比特幣下跌1.4%至8.01萬美元。標普2026年每股收益預期仍因AI支出同比+33%，但股票估值相對國債收益率偏高。
